findings.claim: The generated formatter is emitted without regard to MessagePackSecurity. Contractless string-key deserialization of an attacker-controlled external type relies on the generated StringKey template. If that template builds a dictionary or span lookup of keys, a hash-collision-resistant comparer is not involved. The generator also never routes the generated map and array reads through options.Security.DepthStep. The generated formatter for a type with nested members must call DepthStep. Nothing in the diff checks that this holds for the user-declared formatter path.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a snapshot test with [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] on a partial formatter for an external type with a nested object member. Verify the generated Deserialize calls options.Security.DepthStep(ref reader) and reader.Depth--, then rerun the generator snapshot tests.

findings.claim: The generator discards all diagnostics for [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] (reportDiagnostic: null) in the model path. If a formatter is rejected, for example when the type is not partial or the constructor is not found, no output is produced. The diagnostics are reported only through a separate pipeline step. Generated formatters register in the resolver as ObjectSerializationInfo. If the diagnostics pipeline throws or fails, the failure is silent. This reduces user-visible protection, but it is not a security hole. In particular, ReferenceSymbols.TryCreate failing silently emits no diagnostic.

receipt_plan.detail: Read the generatedFormatterDiagnostics SelectMany. When ReferenceSymbols.TryCreate returns false, it returns an empty array and no diagnostic is shown.
